title: FunApps — Free Canadian Browser Games & Little Escapes
description: A little Canadian arcade: Maritime food games, curious adventures, clickers, puzzles and creative escapes. Pick something and play.

games.name: Donair Dash
games.description: A quick shift at the donair counter. Catch the right toppings in order, dodge the extras, and see how many donairs you can serve in 60 seconds.
controls: Follow the order and catch its toppings in sequence.
Dodge unwanted extras and serve before the 60-second shift ends.

games.name: Clams & Chips: Fryday Rush
games.description: Deep-fried Maritime clam meat and thick-cut chips, fresh from your fry shack. Work two fryers and get the timing right during a 90-second rush.
controls: Manage the clam fryer and chip fryer separately.
Time each batch and serve the orders during the 90-second rush.

games.name: Kitchen Party: Outta Hand!
games.description: The kitchen party has taken on a life of its own. Serve snacks, collect fiddle notes, and dodge hazards across four ways to play.

games.name: Sou’wester Survival
games.description: A very Maritime forecast: donairs, bottles, and fiddles coming your way. Catch the good stuff while steering clear of geese and snowballs.

games.name: True North Turbo
games.description: A rapid-fire gauntlet of Canadian microgames. Read the next challenge, react quickly, and keep the run going.

games.name: Kitchen Party: Coast-to-Coast Chaos
games.description: The guests are getting impatient. Carry supplies through a lively kitchen party, avoid hazards, and keep everyone looked after.

games.name: One More Tune!
games.description: There is always room for one more tune. Match guests to their stations, tap along to the beat, and keep the party moving.

games.name: Double-Double Empire
games.description: Start with coffee and think bigger. Build income, buy upgrades, and collect achievements as your double-double business grows.

games.name: SOME GOOD! — The Great Maritime Gauntlet
games.description: Eight fast East Coast challenges, three mittens, and no time to dawdle. See how long you can hang on through the gauntlet.

games.name: Some Good Kitchen Party
games.description: Step into a 3D kitchen party, keep the guests fed, and find the fiddle tunes that keep the good times going.

games.name: The Trans-Canada Trek
games.description: Set out from St. John’s for Vancouver. Balance fuel, money, car health, and morale on a road trip across Canada.

games.name: Keep ’Er Goin’!
games.description: The kettle, the food, the music—somebody has to keep track of it all. Deal with party emergencies and keep this gathering going.

games.name: YES B’Y! — The Great East Coast Clicker
games.description: Haul traps, earn your next upgrade, and build an Atlantic business one click at a time.

games.name: Out for a Rip
games.description: Head out on an Atlantic delivery run. Get the errands done while the weather does its best to complicate your day.

games.name: Maritime Merchant: The Cabot Trail
games.description: Trade between ports and put your earnings into a better vessel. Make your way through a Maritime merchant’s life.

games.name: Kitchen Party Tycoon
games.description: Turn a kitchen party into a growing operation. Earn Sociables, spend them on upgrades, and keep the gathering getting bigger.

games.name: Some Good Game — East Coast Mayhem
games.description: Take on rapid-fire tasks as the timers shrink. You have three lobster lives to see you through the East Coast mayhem.

games.name: Fog Over Fundy
games.description: Pilot a boat through the fog, use signal flares, and make upgrades while keeping an eye out for the creatures in the mist.
